strings: Sheepishly, m_c tells r_c0 that when {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/stand/stands} up, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/get/gets} really light-headed and dizzy.
Upon standing up, m_c immediately has to sit back down, too lightheaded and dizzy to retain {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} balance.
m_c's been stumbling around the camp more than usual, dizzy and lightheaded from the lack of proper sleep.
